page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal instance featuring 128 dedicated vCPUs and 768.0 GB of system memory. The instance is equipped with four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, providing a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include any local storage, requiring external network-attached storage for persistent data.

The instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. Because there are no local storage drives, all storage operations rely on network-attached volumes, making the 64 Gbps network interface critical for maintaining I/O performance. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention from other tenants.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance represents a high-density hardware profile that consolidates massive CPU resources and multiple enterprise GPUs into a single bare-metal node. This design reduces the overhead of managing multiple smaller instances. The hardware configuration is suited for workloads such as deep learning inference, graphics rendering, high-performance computing, and large-scale parallel processing tasks that require significant GPU acceleration and high network throughput.

The consolidation of high vCPU counts and multiple GPUs provides a dense, high-performance environment for enterprise workloads requiring dedicated compute resources.
